title: Owlshift step envelope
description:
What watch decided a step of a ticket is, so that the child never applies
a stale decision: the kind of step, the ticket ref watch read, and the
generation of the carry it read.

answer.description: The decider's newest edit watch decided on, which lifts a hold.

attempt.description:
This attempt's id, unique to it: the name of its outcome record.
ASCII letters, digits and `-`, at most [`MAX_ATTEMPT`] bytes.

commit.description:
The ticket ref's commit watch read; none for an intake of a ticket
that has no ref yet.

format.description: The format version of this document.

generation.description: The generation of the carry watch read at `commit`, 0 for none.

kept.description:
What watch keeps of the ticket's pull request and the forge's pause,
which the step may change and its outcome gives back.

progress.description:
What the ref kept but its runs' cost when watch read it, as watch
compares it: the hold the child computes keys on it.

KeptFollowing.description:
What watch keeps of a ticket's pull request that a repair or a
correction updates (OWL-219, OWL-232), and the forge's pause, which a
read of the reviews may set: handed to the child and merged back from
its outcome.

moved.description: The stage last recorded as moved out of Owlshift's states.

paused_until.description: No forge read before then: a rate-limited answer.

unposted.description: The owed report's refusal last warned of.

KeptUnposted.description: The commit of an owed report and the refusal warned of.

Shown.description: The visible stage watch read before a resume.

Stage.description: A stage of the pipeline, or `ready` for an admitted ticket not yet started.

StepKind.description: The kind of a step, with what each kind needs that watch alone knows.

oneOf.description: An answer check and its RESUME.

slot_held_by.description:
The ticket whose turn the project's slot is, which the RESUME
names, when another ticket holds it.

oneOf.description: The drain's dispatch, its first stage step.
A resumed stage step, while the tracker shows `shown`.
A fix or a rebase at Watch.

failing_for_ms.description:
How long ago watch first read a failure on the head, in
milliseconds.

merge_refresh.description:
Merge on green's refresh rebase (OWL-445): watch would merge the
green pull request but for its base, which moved since the push,
so the checks ran on a merge with the old base.

oneOf.description: A review loop's start at Watch.

TicketId.description: A tracker's ticket identifier, safe as a git ref component and a file name.
